1. "The Lacemaker" is a painting by Johannes Vermeer, completed around 1669-1670, and it depicts a young woman dressed in a yellow shawl, holding up a pair of bobbins in her left hand as she carefully places a pin in the pillow on which she is making her bobbin lace.
2. Vermeer was a moderately successful provincial genre painter in his lifetime, specializing in domestic interior scenes of middle-class life.
